body.x: SWAN Electronics has presented a smart mirror and mirror display in 'MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT & MIK NIGHT'(BOOTH # 52843) of CES 2019 EUREKA PARK held in Las Vegas, USA for four days starting from January 8 (Tue).
The company has exhibited two types of smart display, mirror-type display and transparent-type display. Transparent displays maximize marketing effect and vividness of an exhibit.

It allows showing three dimensions of the exhibited product in detail as well as advertisement and explanation of the product at the same time. Also, the company is manufacturing different sizes of the smart display which is highly usable in other areas.

The company is developing the product in order for the display to exhibit products for appliance and business in which IoT technology can be applied with software technology like AL, AR, VR touch system.

It supports companies by hosting networking and promotion activities by inviting global investors and buyers, and participating in CES 2019 is one of its global export company fostering programs.
